pilots: none: the box and concepts are steer@4's, whose pilot kept the box

methods.additive: the band lines give each output as base plus a sum of one-band curves (linear interpolation in u); each cell is solved on that model by differential evolution on the baselines' loss, the answer evaluated, the model shifted by the observed residual and solved again, query_iter evaluations per cell
methods.line: steer@2's knob: one raw gain on every band of the task's concepts (negative for a lowered one), the line grid per task
methods.band: the best band-line point, one band of one concept at a time
methods.de: differential evolution on the cell at tier 2 (the baselines' loss: minus the score plus a steep penalty outside the cell), de_maxiter generations of 24, per task
methods.lookup: the best point of the design of experiments
methods.target: design of experiments, one model, then each cell as one query: each raised concept at least t past the zero design, each lowered one at least t below it, where t is the cell's best design-point score plus reach (log10(2) where no design point meets the cell); uniq and coh at least the tier, drift at most drift_max; starts at the best design point; whenever a query meets its goals, t rises by reach and the cell is queried again, until the cell has used budget evaluations or a query ends without meeting them

claims.transfer: on the held-out prompts, the target queries beat the design lookup in more of the 24 cells than they lose to it
claims.model: over the 24 cells on the held-out prompts, the target queries beat the additive model in more cells than they lose; the same count against line, band and de is reported whichever way it falls

after: steer@4 (PR 1812): same concepts, tasks, bands, box, tiers, drift limit, held-out prompts and baselines; 32 training prompts (steer@4's 16 plus 16 new); a new model
